target: Prove actual gradient and ordered half-square divergence for quadratic geometry on real Hilbert spaces. In finite-dimensional real inner-product E, specialize the same Option-valued prescient Bregman selector to convex nonempty closed V, arbitrary EReal losses with ambient no-bottom, finite values and global supporting subgradients on V, and supplied attained feasible quadratic updates. Derive both actual-run equality through T AND new-state regret with full negative squared-movement term. Variable schedule: T>0, played steps positive/nonincreasing, previous-state max distance divided by final step; fixed schedule: eta>0, T may be zero, initial distance divided by eta. x0 need not belong to V. No global existence claim, Lipschitz bound, bounded V or affine restriction is added. Candidate bounded Euclidean prescient leaf only. Seven required Chapter 2 containers and all six future mathematical claims remain open. In particular the whole prescient container is NOT closed: mandatory repair:7.47-terminal and repair:15.31-terminal remain open. B1-B7 and every other difficult target are retained. Chapter 2 partial, accepted=false, complete proof denominator=null; Chapters1-16 Goal ACTIVE. No declaration-count closure, main update, merge, deployment, live verification, purification or native whole-loop acceptance is claimed. Latest main fea256b was merged INTO this isolated candidate branch, not the reverse.
